name: battery-backed space heater

tags.description: A squat ceramic block on a wire frame, with a handle, a dial nobody trusts, and a sealed cell in the base that holds about twelve hours. Plugged in it runs off the wall and quietly tops itself up. When the grid goes - and the grid goes - it keeps going, which is the entire reason to own one and the entire reason they cost what they cost.
